architecture_delta.name: PRODUCTSTART_ADMISSION_BUNDLE_IDENTITY
architecture_delta.problem: Current storage ProductStart lanes separately establish SQLite runtime artifact authority, parent/pre-exec environment policy, and path integrity, but do not yet prove that the launcher and recursively executed/imported admission-guard bytes are the independently accepted release bytes.
architecture_delta.invariant: Before productive Frank state is opened, the exact executable admission bundle must be antecedently accepted and non-caller-selectably bound. The observed systemd parent, launcher, V5 guard and all transitively authoritative guard-code members must resolve to that accepted bundle or ProductStart fails closed.

composition_inputs.PR466: independent SQLite runtime manifest/library artifact authority candidate
composition_inputs.PR470: direct V5 guard loader-environment defense-in-depth candidate

required_next_falsifiers: Reject a root-owned/nonwritable byte-distinct launcher with accepted basename.
Reject a byte-distinct V5 guard while launcher bytes remain accepted.
Reject a byte-distinct transitively imported V4/V3/V2/V1 member.
Rescue exact independently accepted admission bundle.
Prove productive start/restart uses the admitted bundle and accepted SQLite object.
Prove rollback/downgrade/path/library swap fails closed before persisted writable state opens.
promotion_evidence: antecedent release/build authority for admission bundle identity
architecture_delta.rollback: No product mutation performed by this run; requirement can be rejected if an existing stronger non-caller-selectable bundle attestation is found and independently demonstrated to cover the full launcher/guard chain on ProductStart.
